2.192.5
NumericIndicator.Left
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The NumericIndicator.Left element is ignored if it is present. However, its data type is validated,
and the value MUST be a Float ([XMLSCHEMA2] section 3.2.4) or an expression that evaluates to a
Float.
The following is the parent element of the NumericIndicator.Left element.
Parent elements
NumericIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the NumericIndicator.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
